most of you are trading $DACITY like it's another one day event coin

it's not

today rockstar dropped the GTA VI launch trailer

and inside the most anticipated piece of entertainment in human history there's a shitcoin

not a crypto partnership
not a sponsor
a shitcoin that rockstar themselves wrote into the game

the leaks already showed it: lucia's side mission is literally shilling dacity coin for auda-city
today it showed up in the official trailer

think about what that means

rockstar has spent years satirizing every piece of american culture
cars, banks, social media, influencers
and when they decided to satirize crypto, they chose a shitcoin

that's not an accident
that's the biggest cultural validation memecoins have ever gotten

now the part people miss

every narrative we trade dies because the attention dies
a tweet lasts hours
a viral animal lasts days

GTA VI doesn't have an expiry date

nov 19: release
then millions of players doing that mission in-game
then every streamer, every youtuber, every tiktok with "lmao dacity coin"
then years of GTA online

rockstar does it for us, for years

for years we've been asking how we onboard the next wave of retail
ETFs didn't do it
celebrity coins didn't do it
nobody downloaded phantom because of a blackrock headline

my bet is GTA will be one of the main catalysts

because for millions of kids and normies, GTA is their first contact with a world they've never touched
their first heist, their first stock market, their first "investment"

the game becomes the tutorial

rockstar already did

they won't buy because of a whitepaper or a chart
they'll buy because they played it
because it's funny
because they want to own a piece of the game in real life

that's the most powerful reason anyone has ever bought a memecoin

we're 35 days from release

the next wave comes when the normies hit the mission and google 'dacity coin'
